summary: Curated the plan-generated skeleton into source-aware Open Food Facts recipes with compact agent JSON, bounded requests, custom User-Agent posture, and explicit source/rate-limit caveats.
reason: Issue #1375 needs an agent-usable Open Food Facts product-data CLI, not placeholder environment-variable commands or a raw endpoint mirror. The first print keeps the command surface read-only and aligned with Open Food Facts' custom User-Agent, rate-limit, and anti-bulk guidance.
validated_outcome: Unit tests cover v3 product request shape, contact-bearing User-Agent construction, v2 structured search and category parameters, per-barcode comparison errors, upstream error summarization, and source/rate posture. Dogfood validation covers help/version, sources, doctor, product, nutrition, allergen, and compare live commands; live search/category checks were skipped after /api/v2/search returned HTTP 503 and timeout responses during validation.
